Historical 1962 Constitution (constitution-1962): verifies presidential system, cabinet responsibility to President, Basic Democracies electoral college, and Articles 199-206 advisory Council.

First Amendment Act, 1963 (Act I of 1964) (first-amendment-1962): verifies sections 1, 3-4, assent on 10 January 1964, immediate commencement, Islamic Republic title restoration, and fundamental rights chapter insertion.

findings.message: Teaching case illustrations and hypothetical examples: Fictional classroom scenarios (Ayesha in Hyderabad secondary school, Bilal in Larkana teacher education college, student council and library analogies, Tharparkar practicum lesson) are original instructional examples designed for pedagogy and do not represent judicial records, school audits, or empirical survey findings.

Headless review tooling constraint: The crew job brief explicitly prohibits running npm run build, a dev server, or Playwright Chromium. Visual, structural, and presentation checks were conducted via measure-figure-text.mjs (all 8 SVG variants exit 0 with zero overflow or collision), static heading and table container analysis, and Sharp PNG rasterization with CSS variables resolved.

Official 2012 consolidated Constitution edition: Unit 3 explicitly refers to the National Assembly Constitution text updated to 28 February 2012 as a historical reading edition. It systematically discloses amendments (such as Article 2A in 1985 and the Eighteenth Amendment of 2010 including Article 25A) and advises that current legal matters require consulting the latest official text.

Print monographs declared under mapped reading limits: Hamid Khan (2017) and HEC Pakistan Studies text are retained as guide-recommended further reading per D-2026-0001; all factual propositions are fully grounded in verified open-access primary and secondary sources.
